cases.name: lists-insert-item-adds-marker
cases.notes: §5: markdown without a leading `- ` is prefixed with one.

cases.name: lists-insert-item-keeps-marker
cases.notes: §5: markdown already starting with `- ` (after trimming) is used as is.

cases.name: node-set-link-name
cases.notes: §5 node_set: the md:link.name editor retypes only that occurrence's text (byte span → code units) → one `update { markdown, expect }`.

cases.name: node-set-link-value
cases.notes: §5 node_set: md:link.value retargets the whole destination (the `#Section` fragment goes with it).

cases.name: node-set-task-checked
cases.notes: §5 node_set: md:task.checked is an attrs update (`"true"` → true) with the CAS.

cases.name: node-set-not-editable
cases.notes: §5: an md:section node has no editor for `name` → node_not_editable (its `{ kind, prop, editable }` data is not pinned).

cases.name: links-repair
cases.notes: §5 links_repair: whole destinations only — both links in b_1 (the `#Section` fragment re-appended), the list b_2 (top-most; its item b_3's hit is dropped), never the code span (b_4) or the code fence (b_5). `pairs[0].hits` counts the destinations rewritten in the kept blocks.

cases.name: links-repair-path-glob-no-hits
cases.notes: §5: `path_glob` scopes the source documents; no candidate → no ops, no hits, `pairs` with 0 hits; applying no ops commits nothing.

cases.name: links-retarget
cases.notes: §5: the one-pair form; `from` given slash-less matches `/x.md` (leading `/` ignored).
